name: PT Indo American Seafoods Tbk
summary: PT Indo American Seafoods Tbk operates as a seafood manufacturing, processing, farming and seafood catching industry. It focuses on frozen raw and breaded shrimp & tempura, meatballs, nuggets, processing, coking and wholesale activities. The company was founded on April 06, 2006 and is headquartered in Bandar Lampung, Indonesia.
